Provisional: 20 replicates per setting. Manuscript numbers come from the 100-replicate runs.

How to read these tables

EUR panel, ASN panel, …
Standard PRS-CS run with one ancestry's LD reference panel.
PRS-MIX
PRS-CS run with an LD panel blended from the pair's two panels, each weighted by its ancestry's share of the GWAS (for example 70% EUR panel and 30% ASN panel for a 70% EUR, 30% ASN GWAS).
GWAS ancestry mix
The ancestry make-up of the simulated GWAS. Each pair is tested at three mixes.
Scored in
The held-out individuals whose scores are evaluated. They are in neither the GWAS nor the LD panels.
r2 with true genetic value
Squared correlation between people's scores and their true simulated genetic values. 1 is perfect, 0 is no information.
MSE
Mean squared error between people's scores and their true genetic values. Unlike r2, it also penalises scores that are on the wrong scale, for example spread far more widely than the true values. The table gives PRS-MIX's MSE as a percentage change from each single panel's: −40% means PRS-MIX's error is 40% smaller.
Top-10% overlap
Of the people PRS-MIX ranks in its top 10%, the share that the single panel also ranks in its top 10%.
Rerun, new seed
The same single panel run again with a different random seed. Its overlap with the original run shows how much the top 10% changes from sampler randomness alone. It is the yardstick for PRS-MIX.
Percentage points
The plain difference between two percentages: 88% minus 91% is −3 percentage points. Negative means PRS-MIX changes who is in the top 10% more than rerunning the same panel does.
Numbers in parentheses
Standard errors over the simulation replicates. Differences are paired: within a replicate, every method analyses the same GWAS and scores the same people.

Table 1. Accuracy: how well scores track true genetic value

How well each method's scores track true genetic value. r2 measures how well scores rank people; MSE also checks that scores are on the right scale. The r2 differences subtract each single panel's r2 from PRS-MIX's. The MSE columns give PRS-MIX's MSE as a percentage change from the single panel's, averaged on the log scale over replicates (geometric mean) with delta-method standard errors. Chromosome 22, fixed 250 kb LD blocks. Means over 20 replicates, standard errors in parentheses; differences are paired within replicate.

Simulation and analysis settings for the sweep.

ItemValue
Ancestry pairsEUR and ASN, EUR and AFR, EUR and SAS, ASN and AFR
GWAS ancestry mixes90:10, 70:30 and 50:50 for each pair

LD blocksfixed 250 kb, shared by both panels
